description: Findings only: the same system prompt structure and essential screenshots as v3, but each criterion's evidence is only what failing checks found (one plain-words line per issue, merged across states, content variants and widths) and observation measurements outside or close to their reference. Passing checks, in-range measurements, selectors, boxes and collection details are left out; states are described by what they are. Failing-check issues are numbered and outlined in red on the screenshots.
